purpose: retrospective historical DC usable-quantity proxy compared with one later published controlled test
design_status: retrospective; all published ID01 reference values previously seen; new June/July 2019 raw curves not acquired or inspected at freeze time

source.metadata_status: publisher-gathered, not guaranteed exact physical bounds
source.monthly_files_role: June history and July test diagnostics required; full months quality-only, feature builder explicitly slices frozen history

reference.status: author-reported controlled field DC usable quantities; shared measurement chain, not VPP commitment truth
reference.numbers_role: labels only, not used to pick history, anchors or candidate intervals

information.embargo_basis: conservative engineering assumption inspired by author average preparation/test/follow-up of about two days; actual prep onset unknown
information.available_time_assumption: all included native rows are retrospectively available by history cutoff; no actual reception logs
information.timezone: native source strings only; absolute timezone not assumed
information.isolation: rows at or after cutoff, including test/preparation, excluded from feature computation; labels joined after selection
information.history_basis: exact duration of v1 history, translated to next chronological test; fixed before any new raw curve reading
information.left_boundary: no carry-in anchor before start; existing v1 rule; all missing-high cases retained

rest_proxy.anchor: first confirmation row: start+299 native seconds, median voltage of last 60 rows divided by 40
rest_proxy.maximal_runs: contiguous finite non-interpolated rows with abs(I)<=0.15; use only first confirmation per run

roles.current_threshold: 0.01C of nominal 15Ah, within publisher candidate range; fixed engineering choice
roles.duration: publisher says several minutes; 300s is fixed engineering choice, no fitted OCV
roles.high_threshold: publisher describes S_LMO EOC relaxation region above 4.1V; proxy not proof of full SOC
roles.low_threshold: 3.5V is explicit engineering low-voltage proxy, not manufacturer EOD or proven SOC=0
roles.tail_median: noise-resistant recorded-voltage proxy; not fitted equilibrium OCV

pairing.rule: scan anchors chronologically; latest high anchor becomes open start, middle anchors leave it open; each low consumes that start even if resulting interval fails; no repeated low reuse
pairing.integration: left rectangle on native timestamps [high_anchor, low_anchor); low_anchor is needed to confirm terminal state and is excluded from integral
pairing.quality: all rows from high through low anchor inclusive are finite, native consecutive seconds, Interpolated=0; no added interpolation or lag correction
pairing.sign_requirement: net measured Ah and UI energy strictly positive; any charging inside interval retained and reported
pairing.missing_start: low anchor with no preceding high is recorded, never invented
pairing.selection: latest eligible low-anchor available before cutoff; deterministic ties by high-anchor; no selection by reference proximity
pairing.fallback: if no candidate qualifies, feature remains unavailable; no nominal fill or exclusion of target test

sample.unit: one controlled field test event, not seconds or historical intervals
sample.split: single subsequent chronological retrospective evaluation, no fit; published reference already seen

changes: v3 advances chronologically to third test with same duration, embargo, algorithm and comparisons; clarifies metadata text and explicit unavailable output policy for raw cadence/coverage failure; old frozen versions unchanged

history_admission_failure_policy.requirement: exact frozen 1002219 native consecutive seconds with finite values and valid published interpolation flags; no resampling, widening or cadence conversion
history_admission_failure_policy.if_failed: retain target event; B_HIST_SPAN unavailable due raw_history_not_admitted; B_NOM/B_DS still evaluated for their supported outputs; no fabricated anchors or integrals
history_admission_failure_policy.quality_scope: full-month quality diagnostics separate from frozen history eligibility; interpolation inside history retained and disqualifies affected spans per v1
history_admission_failure_policy.verification: independently count native history rows/cadence/finite/flags from raw; verify empty unavailable proxy and original published reference

baseline.purpose: limited exploratory comparison of fixed metadata and historical measured voltage-span proxy against one controlled DC test

B_DS.fit: none; datasheet value may contain reserve/warranty convention

B_HIST_SPAN.fit: none; no offset current, SOH scaling, calibrated OCV or efficiency fit
B_HIST_SPAN.fallback: unavailable, retain target event and failure status

baseline.reference: published third chronological ID01 controlled test selected by outer reference key; numeric values used as labels only

metrics.reporting: one event per supported output; report availability/failure for every model, no uncertainty interval, significance or accuracy claim
metrics.common_comparison: B_NOM vs B_HIST_SPAN capacity; B_NOM/B_DS/B_HIST_SPAN energy only where predictions exist; unavailable predictions are never dropped silently

baseline.boundaries: history anchors are recorded-voltage proxies, not guaranteed full/empty states; natural low-rate intervals and maximum-power tests differ; internal BMS/balancing drain may be unseen; no causal or VPP commitment claim
baseline.test_usage: known reference used only for declared retrospective comparison, not independent confirmation
baseline.implementation_status: frozen before new raw acquisition, no new scoring yet
baseline.change_control: no threshold/lag/loss/endpoint search after scoring; new method means new protocol
baseline.unavailable_history: retain event and both B_HIST_SPAN outputs with raw_history_not_admitted if original history cannot be evaluated; no nominal fill

failure_policy: retain chosen event even if no eligible spans; never extend history or replace event after observing results; failed acquisition/admission must be recorded before retry
